obfuscation_indicators: unable to make reasonably reliable estimates
risk_summary: The excerpt is generally transparent and well quantified, with detailed sales, earnings, acquisition, debt, interest-rate, and working-capital metrics. The tone is predominantly confident and growth-oriented, although reliance on acquisitions, $3.1 billion of debt, excluded tax obligations, and guarantees to affiliates create identifiable credit risks. Some forward-looking promotional language and limitations on contractual-obligation estimates modestly reduce disclosure precision.
